teaser: What does it mean to want command over the material world and distrust nearly every system built to hold it? That is the crossing here: life path 8, the Powerhouse, set inside an INTP mind that tests a claim before it accepts it. The 8 wants to build something that lasts in money, rank, and reach. The INTP wants the idea proven first, independent of whoever is asking. The result can be a business built from first principles, argued with on the days it only works because other people need it to.
